_readme: Dirac owns the session mode ids and the tool names below. LeapMux owns no value in this file. Both sides read them -- the worker falls back to the safe mode and maps the `use_subagents` card to a subagent registry row, and the browser plugin wires the plan toggle and draws the same card from the same words. The `rawInput` field that names a tool is `tool`, spelled in each provider's own struct tag; the name it carries is the `toolNames` value.
